title: OrderList
description: A list of `demo.order` legs. Mirrors experimental `fdc3.orderList` (which only wraps `fdc3.order` identifiers) so multi-name blotters and baskets keep instrument, side, and quantity. Context for `demo.CreateOrder` and `demo.SubmitOrder` when more than one stock is involved.

id.title: Order List Identifiers
id.description: Same role as `fdc3.orderList.id` — optional identifiers for the list in an OMS, EMS, or related system.

name.title: Name
name.description: An optional human-readable summary of the order list.

orders.title: List of Orders
orders.description: An array of `demo.order` contexts that forms the list.
